description: Set gain/delay (number, ramped) or mute/solo (boolean) on the crosspoints of an input×output selection (Mixer.SetCrossPoint{Gain,Delay,Mute,Solo}). This MUTATES the running/emulated system. Read mixer state back via qsys_get_component.

inputs.description: Input selector — QRC String Syntax: "*" (all), "1 2 3"/"1,2,3" (list), "1-6" (range), "!3" (negate), combinable ("1-8 !3")

outputs.description: Output selector — QRC String Syntax: "*" (all), "1 2 3"/"1,2,3" (list), "1-6" (range), "!3" (negate), combinable ("1-8 !3")

ramp.description: Ramp time in seconds — gain/delay only, ignored otherwise

value.description: Number (dB/seconds) for gain/delay; boolean for mute/solo

name: qsys_mixer_set_crosspoint
title: Set mixer crosspoint(s)
